snippet.title: CONFINED: LEAVING OKB-134 | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person Horror/Puzzle Adventure game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

MAJOR DEMO UPDATE OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195810/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134_Demo/
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816730/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134/

Coming 2026 for PC and VR
https://www.fiend-games.com/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
